The plugin this repository's marketplace offers, and the marketplace source is `"./"`, so the plugin root IS the repository root. That is what makes both halves of the offer reachable from a consumer's plugin cache: `skills` points at the repository-root `skills/` directory (the canonical arch-* skills, host-independent SKILL.md files), and `lspServers` launches the package's own server at `packages/archkeep/lsp.mjs` with `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` resolved to wherever this plugin was installed. The route stays on the four extensions ESLint cannot reach — the argument lives in `src/lsp/editor-config.integration.test.mjs`, which pins this list against the analyzer registry.

`version` is synchronized with `packages/archkeep/package.json` — release-please bumps both via `extra-files` in `release-please-config.json`, and `src/conformance/plugin-catalogue.integration.test.mjs` plus `scripts/check-skills.mjs` fail when they drift. An installed plugin is cached per version, so an unbumped edit reaches nobody.
name: archkeep
description: Module-boundary diagnostics at edit time, and architecture agent skills, for Go, Rust, Python, Vue, Java, Kotlin and C#
